info.name: BuildTwin 360 - Daily Progress Report (DPR) API Module
info.description:
Enterprise Postman Collection for Daily Progress Report (DPR), DPR Activity Management & Activity Quantity Tracking in BuildTwin 360.
Covers:
0. Authentication & Token Extraction
1. Daily Progress Report (DPR) Core CRUD & Dashboards
2. DPR Activity APIs (Add, List, Get by ID, Update, Delete, WBS Activity DPR Progress History)
3. Activity Quantity Tracking (DPR Summary, Single Activity Analytics, Project-Wide Quantity Tracking Dashboard)
4. Other Line Items (Labor, Equipment, Materials, Photos)
5. Review & Approval Workflow (Submit, Approve with WBS cascade, Reject with reason)

Base URL: http://localhost:8080
